backend: native extension; spatial SQL only; no model loaded

deep_wells_near_pipeline.sql:
SELECT w.OBJECTID
FROM wells_m w
WHERE w.water_depth > 350
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM service_pipelines_m p
    WHERE ST_DWithin(w.geom_m, p.geom_m, 5000)
  )
ORDER BY w.OBJECTID;

deep_wells_without_near_pipeline.sql:
SELECT w.OBJECTID
FROM wells_m w
WHERE w.water_depth > 350
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM service_pipelines_m p
    WHERE ST_DWithin(w.geom_m, p.geom_m, 5000)
  )
ORDER BY w.OBJECTID;

wells_within_discovery.sql:
SELECT w.OBJECTID
FROM wells_m w
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM discovery_areas d
  WHERE ST_Within(w.geometry, d.geometry)
)
ORDER BY w.OBJECTID;

pipelines_intersecting_discovery.sql:
SELECT p.OBJECTID
FROM service_pipelines_m p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM discovery_areas d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(p.geometry, d.geometry)
)
ORDER BY p.OBJECTID;

discoveries_containing_wells.sql:
SELECT d.OBJECTID
FROM discovery_areas d
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM wells_m w
  WHERE ST_Contains(d.geometry, w.geometry)
)
ORDER BY d.OBJECTID;

wells_outside_all_discoveries.sql:
SELECT w.OBJECTID
FROM wells_m w
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM discovery_areas d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(w.geometry, d.geometry)
)
ORDER BY w.OBJECTID;

deep_wells_within_discovery_near_pipelin.sql:
SELECT w.OBJECTID
FROM wells_m w
WHERE w.water_depth > 350
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM discovery_areas d
    WHERE ST_Within(w.geometry, d.geometry)
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM service_pipelines_m p
    WHERE ST_DWithin(w.geom_m, p.geom_m, 5000)
  )
ORDER BY w.OBJECTID;

nearest_pipeline_to_deep_well.sql:
SELECT w.OBJECTID AS well_id, nearest.pipeline_id, nearest.distance_m
FROM wells_m w
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT p.OBJECTID AS pipeline_id,
         ST_Distance(w.geom_m, p.geom_m) AS distance_m
  FROM service_pipelines_m p
  ORDER BY distance_m, p.OBJECTID
  LIMIT 1
) nearest
WHERE w.water_depth > 350
ORDER BY w.OBJECTID;
